invariants.rationale: The method always returns the output of either handleInsert or handleUpdate, both of which are expected to return non-null iterators.
partitioner is unconditionally cast and invoked without null checks, so it is assumed to be non-null at this point.
partition is used as an argument to getBucketInfo and for error messages, assumed non-null.
The method always returns an Iterator<List<WriteStatus>> as per its signature.
instantTime is used at method entry as a parameter and likely invariantly non-null throughout method execution.
